name: NGC 1271 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1271, a compact early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1271-hubble
story: NGC 1271 is a small, dense galaxy in the Perseus Cluster, yet the black hole at its heart is far heavier than the galaxy's modest bulge light would predict.

claims.text: NGC 1271 is an early-type galaxy in the Perseus Cluster
Its black hole is far heavier than its bulge luminosity predicts
NGC 1271 is one of the compact elliptical galaxies imaged in HST program 13050
